not_qualified: Wikipedia-only entries of 26 Nov: Saudi strikes on 50 Houthi targets; Niger National Guard attack at Sanam; Niger State (Nigeria) gunmen; Bangladesh factory closures; Eldridge-led consortium to buy Lukoil's international assets (AP); Bangchak refinery fire in Bangkok; Cambridgeshire train stabbing verdict; Giza tanker arrest; Beirut minibus shootout; Serbian parliament sets presidential election for 27 Dec; Chinese golf-course closures; Guinea-Bissau election postponed to 2028; FCC authorises SpaceX Starmind satellites.
Czech items seen only in ČT24 (energy price rises; Červený interview on KRNAP): not significant events of the day.
Macy's parade postponement, Mackenzie conviction and Iowa detonation belong to 25 Nov or earlier.

events.title: Euro Summit and European Council back Pablo Hernández de Cos as next ECB President
Drone strike in Kuwait kills two Italian Rheinmetall technicians; Italy says the drone was Iranian-made
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file (not in stories, running or dropped). Unscheduled attack, not announced in advance; the Iran war sweep did not pick up Gulf-state strikes beyond Hormuz shipping (gulf-shipping covers UKMTO reports only).

events.title: US forces disable the Palau-flagged merchant ship Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman for trying to breach the blockade of Iranian ports
events.note: gulf-shipping was planned on UKMTO/JMIC reports only, so a CENTCOM enforcement action was outside its claim. Not announced in advance; CENTCOM statements are the source.

events.title: Malta-flagged tanker sinks off Ibiza: one crew member dead, 16 rescued, diesel spill feared
events.note: Not in the planning file. Accident, not announced in advance.

events.title: Mexico files a formal complaint with the United States over DEA tip lines on alleged organised-crime figures
events.note: Not in the planning file. Low weight; not announced in advance (Wikipedia files it under 26 and 27 Nov).

events.title: Chamber of Deputies holds the second reading of the cut in unemployment benefits, late in the night to Friday; also approves the state's D35 commitments
events.note: Planned as conditional story cz-benefits (cz-benefits-27, 23% after the evening check, to run only at 50% or more); moved to the diary by the morning. The planning file carries the second reading in the diary.

events.title: Heavy snow paralyses transport in Vysočina, D1 closed for hours, buses and Brno trams delayed
events.note: The ČHMÚ heavy-snow warning for south-east Czechia was in the planning file's dropped list: 'weather forecast; excluded'. The consequences (road chaos) were not an event the paper tracked.

events.title: Senate public hearing on national defence: President Pavel warns of Russia and missing crisis legislation, Minister Zůna presents CZK 148bn of projects
events.note: Dropped list: statements of known positions at a hearing, attendance only; diary.

events.title: Chamber media committee holds the public hearing on ČT/ČRo financing; Minister Klempíř sees no reason for constitutional safeguards of independence
events.note: Dropped list: hearing, no vote; diary.

events.title: Appeal court in Plzeň spares Roman Berbr a prison sentence in the football-corruption case
events.note: Dropped list: date of the ruling not confirmed by any news outlet (only an aggregator); dossier cz-berbr-27 kept. The ruling came on Thursday.

events.title: Interior minister sets 9 January for repeated municipal voting in four municipalities where courts annulled the October results
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Decision published in the Collection of Laws on Thursday; no date announced in advance that our sources showed. Low weight.
